title: Hotshot and car hauler
scope: Heavy-duty pickup with an open or enclosed gooseneck car-hauler trailer. The 49 CFR 393.128 securement lesson applies to transported automobiles, light trucks and vans weighing 10,000 pounds or less. Heavier vehicles require the applicable 49 CFR 393.130 branch.

applicability.hotshot-open: Open car-hauler operations, exposed loading and securement inspection
applicability.hotshot-enclosed: Enclosed car-trailer clearance, doors and interior access
applicability.enclosedCargoRule: Enclosed trailers remain subject to applicable cargo securement requirements

units.example: I operate a heavy-duty pickup with a car-hauler trailer.
The dually is rated for this trailer.
The gooseneck trailer is coupled in the truck bed.
This car-hauler trailer carries three vehicles.
The open car hauler has two loading ramps.
The enclosed trailer protects the vehicle from weather.
The low-profile trailer reduces the loading angle.
The trailer deck is clear and dry.
This wide vehicle requires drive-over fenders.
The strap is routed inside the rub rail.
Use only a rated attachment point, not a damaged stake pocket.
I checked both trailer axles for leaks and damage.
The tandem dual trailer has eight tires.
The trailer GVWR is printed on the certification label.
I verified the gross combination weight rating before dispatch.
The coupler is locked over the gooseneck ball.
The gooseneck coupler shows no cracks or damage.
The coupler latch is fully closed and secured.
Both safety chains are attached to rated points.
The breakaway cable is connected independently.
The breakaway switch and battery are secure.
The seven-pin connector is seated and locked.
I tested the trailer brake controller before moving.
The brake gain is set for the current load.
Both landing legs are fully raised for travel.
The drop-leg jack is pinned in the travel position.

units.translation: зазор между гусаком и кузовом пикапа

units.word: Center the vehicle on the trailer.
units.example: Move two inches to the driver side and center the vehicle.
The spotter is standing where I can see him.
Move slightly toward the driver side.
The right tires are too close to the passenger-side edge.
The front overhang is clear of the pickup cab.
The rear overhang does not block the trailer lights.
The load position gives safe weight distribution.
The pin weight must stay within the pickup rating.
The scale ticket shows each axle weight.
Mark the correct load position before tightening the straps.

units.word: Set the loaded vehicle's parking brake.
units.example: The vehicle is positioned and its parking brake is set.
Remove the keys after the vehicle is secured.
Both ramps are pinned and cannot slide out.
The wheel strap is centered over the tire tread.
The over-the-tire strap is not touching the body panel.
Use the approved attachment method for this vehicle.
The ratchet handle is fully closed.
Replace the ratchet strap if the webbing is cut.
The chain binder is secured against accidental release.

units.translation: точка крепления с указанной допустимой нагрузкой
units.example: Using rated and marked anchor points is recommended practice; the rule requires mounting points designed for that purpose.
units.regulatoryNote: FMCSA encourages manufacturers to rate and mark anchor points. For vehicles within 49 CFR 393.128, the enforceable text requires mounting points designed for that purpose; it does not universally require a displayed anchor rating.

units.example: The manufacturer identifies the approved attachment points.
The working load limit is marked on the tiedown.
Every tiedown is in good condition and properly attached.

units.word: Secure the vehicle at the front and rear.
units.example: Each transported vehicle is restrained at the front and rear.

units.word: Keep straps clear of body panels.
units.translation: Не допускайте контакта ремней с кузовными панелями.
units.example: The straps do not rub against the bumper or body.
The webbing lies flat across the tire.

units.translation: Повторно осматривайте груз в установленные моменты.
units.example: I reinspect within the first 50 miles and again at a duty-status change, after three hours or after 150 miles, whichever comes first.
units.regulatoryNote: 49 CFR 392.9(b)(2)-(3), subject to the sealed-load and impracticable-inspection exceptions in 392.9(b)(4).

situations.title: Pickup and gooseneck roadside inspection
situations.goal: Назвать тип автопоезда, весовые ratings и показать сцепку
situations.visual: Pickup with gooseneck car hauler in inspection lane

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.english: Is this pickup and trailer operated as a commercial combination?
dialogue.translation: Этот пикап с прицепом используется как коммерческий автопоезд?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Yes. I am transporting vehicles for hire.
dialogue.translation: Да. Я перевожу автомобили за плату.

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.english: Show me the pickup rating, trailer rating and shipping documents.
dialogue.translation: Покажите рейтинг пикапа, рейтинг прицепа и транспортные документы.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: The ratings are on the certification labels, and the documents are here.
dialogue.translation: Рейтинги указаны на сертификационных табличках, документы здесь.

situations.title: Auction pickup and VIN check
situations.goal: Найти автомобиль и сверить VIN до погрузки
situations.visual: Pickup and empty car hauler at an auction gate

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: What lot number and vehicle are you picking up?
dialogue.translation: Какой номер лота и какой автомобиль вы забираете?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Lot four eighteen, a silver sedan. I need to verify the VIN.
dialogue.translation: Лот четыреста восемнадцать, серебристый седан. Мне нужно сверить VIN.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: It is in row B. Bring the release form to the exit gate.
dialogue.translation: Он в ряду B. Привезите форму выдачи к выездным воротам.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Understood. I will inspect it before loading.
dialogue.translation: Понял. Я осмотрю его до погрузки.

situations.title: Loading an inoperable vehicle
situations.goal: Уточнить состояние автомобиля и безопасно использовать лебедку
situations.visual: Inoperable car aligned with trailer ramps

dialogue.speaker: Dispatcher
dialogue.english: The vehicle does not run. Can you load it with your winch?
dialogue.translation: Автомобиль не на ходу. Вы можете погрузить его лебедкой?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Yes, if the steering is unlocked and the brakes release.
dialogue.translation: Да, если руль разблокирован и тормоза отпускают.

dialogue.speaker: Dispatcher
dialogue.english: The keys are with the auction office. Call if the condition is different.
dialogue.translation: Ключи в офисе аукциона. Позвоните, если состояние другое.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: I will inspect it and keep everyone clear of the winch line.
dialogue.translation: Я осмотрю автомобиль и прослежу, чтобы все держались подальше от троса.

situations.title: Vehicle securement check
situations.goal: Объяснить крепление каждого автомобиля спереди и сзади
situations.visual: Inspector checking wheel straps on a car-hauler trailer

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.english: Explain how each vehicle is secured.
dialogue.translation: Объясните, как закреплен каждый автомобиль.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Each vehicle is restrained at the front and rear with rated tiedowns.
dialogue.translation: Каждый автомобиль закреплен спереди и сзади расчетными средствами крепления.

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.english: This wheel strap is loose. Tighten it before you move.
dialogue.translation: Этот колесный ремень ослаблен. Затяните его до начала движения.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Understood. I will tighten it and recheck every attachment point.
dialogue.translation: Понял. Я затяну его и повторно проверю каждую точку крепления.

situations.title: Scale and axle weights
situations.goal: Запросить осевые веса и исправить распределение нагрузки
situations.visual: Pickup and loaded trailer on a certified scale

dialogue.speaker: Scale Clerk
dialogue.english: Your trailer axles are over the planned weight.
dialogue.translation: Оси прицепа превышают запланированный вес.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Please print the pickup and trailer axle weights separately.
dialogue.translation: Распечатайте отдельно веса осей пикапа и прицепа.

dialogue.speaker: Scale Clerk
dialogue.english: The axle weights are listed on the second line.
dialogue.translation: Веса осей указаны во второй строке.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will correct the load position before departure.
dialogue.translation: Спасибо. Я исправлю положение груза до выезда.

situations.title: Customer delivery and condition report
situations.goal: Провести совместный осмотр и получить подпись
situations.visual: Driver and customer inspecting a delivered car

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Please inspect the vehicle before you sign the delivery report.
dialogue.translation: Осмотрите автомобиль перед подписанием акта доставки.

dialogue.speaker: Receiver
dialogue.english: I see a scratch on the left rear door.
dialogue.translation: Я вижу царапину на левой задней двери.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: That scratch is marked on the pickup condition report and photos.
dialogue.translation: Эта царапина отмечена в акте при получении и на фотографиях.

dialogue.speaker: Receiver
dialogue.english: I found the notation. I will sign the delivery report.
dialogue.translation: Я нашел отметку. Я подпишу акт доставки.

situations.title: Loading a low car into an enclosed trailer
situations.goal: Проверить рампу и внутренние зазоры при ограниченном обзоре
situations.visual: Low car aligned with the rear ramp of an enclosed gooseneck trailer

dialogue.speaker: Spotter
dialogue.english: The front bumper is close to the ramp. Move forward slowly.
dialogue.translation: Передний бампер близко к рампе. Медленно двигайтесь вперед.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Tell me if the roof or mirrors get close to the trailer.
dialogue.translation: Скажите, если крыша или зеркала приблизятся к прицепу.

dialogue.speaker: Spotter
dialogue.english: The roof is clear. Move two inches toward the passenger side.
dialogue.translation: Сверху свободно. Сместитесь на два дюйма к пассажирской стороне.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Understood. I will stop before opening the driver's door.
dialogue.translation: Понял. Я остановлюсь до открытия водительской двери.

situations.title: Enclosed trailer securement inspection
situations.goal: Подтвердить крепление автомобиля и закрытие всех дверей
situations.visual: Inspector checking an enclosed car trailer behind a dually pickup

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.english: Are the vehicle and all trailer doors secured for travel?
dialogue.translation: Автомобиль и все двери прицепа закреплены для движения?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Yes. The vehicle is tied down, and every door is locked.
dialogue.translation: Да. Автомобиль закреплен, все двери заперты.

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.english: Open the side access door so I can view the front tiedowns.
dialogue.translation: Откройте боковую дверь, чтобы я мог осмотреть передние крепления.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: I will open it after confirming the trailer is safely parked.
dialogue.translation: Я открою ее после проверки, что прицеп безопасно припаркован.
